ocl.definition: findCard:BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(c | c.CardID = cardid), newCard:BankCard = if findCard.oclIsUndefined() then BankCard.allInstance()->any() else null endif
ocl.postcondition: let newCard:BankCard in newCard.oclIsNew() and (findCard.oclIsUndefined() implies BankCard.allInstance()->includes(newCard)) and (not findCard.oclIsUndefined() implies result = false) and (not findCard.oclIsUndefined() implies result = true)
